speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Health in the past two years (a) how many applications has the Ministry received to import embryos back to Singapore for Assisted Reproductive Technology procedures; (b) how many of such applications have been successful; and (c) what are the main reasons provided for rejections.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can the Parliamentary Secretary share what are the other reasons why there was such a high rate of rejection?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Two, I asked earlier whether MOH can establish a standardised application form so that people can just fill in to apply to import the embryos back to Singapore.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I think that will help reduce the stigma of couples undergoing IVF and also reduce the stress.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, a standard application, rather than an appeal which makes them feel like they are begging to import their own embryos back to Singapore.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, that is something that they would need to align with.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: In respect of the other point about the standard forms for application, I recall that we had this exchange, about a year back, in relation to this matter and Mr Louis Ng had raised this point about making it convenient and using a standard form.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: We had taken on board Mr Ng's previous suggestion.
